description: 대전광역시 서구_CCTV(교통단속, 정보수집, 재난재해) 현황 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대전광역시 서구. 또한 관리기관명과 관리기관 전화번호를 포함하여 유지관리 체계와 관련 기관 정보를 확인할 수 있으며, 도로종류, 설치장소, 제한속도 등 교통 및 재난 대응과 직접적으로 연관된 항목을. Coverage: 대전광역시 서구. The portal files it under the publisher 대전광역시 서구. Its tags are 무인단속, CCTV위치, 제한속도, CCTV, 교통단속. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
